notes.title: Axis Games releases Meld on Greenlight
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Danny Jugan here from Axis Games. I don't usually do cross-game promotions, but there is some mutual benefit for everyone in this situation. When Axis Football 2015 was Greenlit on Steam, we were about 80% finished with another game we were working on called Meld.

When we finished working on AF 2015, we turned back to Meld to finish things up there before turning back to working on the AF 2016. With our KS failing to raise what we hoped it would, we could use all of the revenue we can get in order to make the game the best it can be.  Getting Meld Greenlit on Steam would help us accomplish that!

If you have a second - check out the Greenlight page for Meld below and shoot us a 'Yes' vote if you feel inclined.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=603369730

For those of you who are curious, our work on Meld will not delay our plans for AF 2016. When we projected timelines and goals, we took the time it would take us to finish Meld into consideration. In fact, breaking from AF for ~2 months allowed us time to hire some folks to create some nice GUI styles and mo-cap animations for the game.

As always, I sincerely appreciate the support everyone has shown us!

Best,

Danny Jugan
danny@AxisGamesOnline.com
@AxisGamesDev
fb.com/AxisGames

notes.title: Asking For The Community's Help
notes.content:
Hi folks – Danny Jugan here with a favor to ask.

We're four days into the Axis Football 2016 Kickstarter, and we have raised about $800 of our $10,000 goal. We are off to a decent start, but projecting the current pledge rate to the end of the campaign will bring us up short of our goal. I need your help in spreading the word about the Kickstarter. If you are considering pledging to support the project, I would encourage you to do so now to continue the momentum that we have started.

My transparent goal with this game has always been to create the game that the fans have wanted. I need some help to get the game to a visual level that meets expectations. Axis Football 2016 can be a huge Leap forward with everyone's support. This is your chance to do something about the monopoly that exists in this area of gaming. 

Tell your friends, send out emails, make Facebook posts, tweet about it, put a video on YouTube, post it on reddit. I am all in with this game, and I am asking you to utilize whatever connections you have to share the word!

Here is the link to the Kickstarter and some Twitter and Facebook posts that you can like, share, and retweet.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/169597452/axis-football-2016

https://twitter.com/axisgamesdev/status/663402563950272512

https://www.facebook.com/AxisGames/posts/10153582324820255

notes.title: Axis Football 16 Kickstart Pledge Levels (Draft)

Danny Jugan here!  Now that Axis Football has been out for a few months, I hope you've come to see that we do things a bit differently here at Axis Games (in a good way ːsteamhappyː) from other developers.  Our goal with this franchise is to make the game that the community wants to play.  The updates we've done have come directly from the fans, and we plan to keep it that way!

To that end, I thought it would be a good idea - as unconventional as this is - to release the first draft of pledge levels for our upcoming Kickstarter campaign.  These are subject to change, and I would love to get the feedback of the community.  Afterall, the success or failure of the campaign rests on whether or not you like what you see!

We're currently working on the KS video and the full feature list of we'll be adding in the 2016 version. You guys have been great about letting us know what features and improvements you want!  We plan to launch the KS campaign in a few weeks, but wanted to get some early feedback from you guys!

notes.title: Patch 3.0 is live! Hot Routes, New Uniforms, Defensive Shifts, and More Modding!
notes.content:
Hi folks! Danny Jugan here with complete patch notes for Axis Football Patch 3.0

Video Rundown of Patch Notes - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7IZ3B2DlJdQ

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
   [*]You can now fully mod the height and weight of all the players in the game. In the root directory of the game's files, you'll find a folder named Mods. 
	This folder contains all of the modable content in the game. To mod the height and/or weight of players, open the Rosters folder and select the corresponding team.
   [*]Height and weight now affect in-game metrics.
   [*]You can now fully mod the audio in the game. View the full video here - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JDbZZL7D5WI
   [*]Added new skin tone mod options for the game.  You'll notice in the Mods folder rosters files for each team that the "b" or "w" skin color option has been replaced with a number.  
	The skin tones range from 1 to 6 where 1 is the lightest (white) skin and 6 is the darkest (black) skin. 
   [*]You can now move the pass aim circle before the snap when using a controller. This makes throwing quick passes to the sides of the field much easier.
   [*]Added six new player stats (Throwing Power, Fitness, Awareness, Agility, Coverage, and Hit Power) for every player in the game.  
	These attributes effect the performance of the players in various aspects of the game. The Player Stats Excel and text files for each team have been updated in the Mods folder to reflect the new attributes.  
	If you have modified team stats in the past, it is recommended that you copy & paste from your modified excel file into the new excel file to work from there.
   [*]Team ratings (Pass, Run, Pass Def, Run Def, Special Teams) are now dynamically loaded in from each team's player stats text file instead of being embedded into the game.  
	This allows players to modify the number of stars each team has in the team selection screen.  The excel file inside of Mods > Player Stats has built-in formulas for calculating the stars for each category. 
	If you use the Excel file (highly recommended) to modify individual player attributes, the stars for that team will automatically update.
   [*]Added the ability to give Hot Routes to all receivers (including TEs and RBs).  Additionally, you can even instruct TEs and RBs to block or run a route.  View the full video on Hot Routes here - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DqPV1AFq-9Q
   [*]Made all Hot Routes completely modable. There are six total Hot Routes, and you can change or edit any or all of them.
   [*]The kicker's name will now show before kickoffs, extra points, and field goals.
   [*]Added new, custom uniform designs for all teams!  Thanks, Ace Bailey!
   [*]Added a music toggle on/off button to the title screen so you can disable the music. Your preference will be saved in between game play sessions.
   [*]The clock will now start when the receiver catches the ball on kickoffs rather than when the ball is kicked.
   [*]Added new idle animations for QB, Linebackers, and Kickers that are used before a play starts.  These add a bit more realism since the previous animations were more like stills.
   [*]You can now shift your defensive line, linebackers, and defensive backs before a play starts.  Press X/C or LBump/RBump to shift DL, Press Q/E or LTrigger/RTrigger to shift LBs, and Press R/F or Y+Up/Down to Shift DBs.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Increased the leg size of the player models to make them more proportionally correct.
   [*]Slightly adjusted the mesh of the jersey number so that it didn't stick out/poke into the jersey as much during certain animations.
   [*]Adjusted the camera angles to bring the player closer to the action in several situations.
   [*]Improved the defensive AI for reacting to and identifying runs.
   [*]Lowered the volume of the music on the title & season screens.

[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Running out of the back of the endzone on a kickoff now properly ends the play.
   [*]Fixed the range that kickers are able to make FGs to be more in line with reality.
   [*]Fixed the bug that was causing the pass, rush, and total yards allowed stats to be equal to each other.
   [*]Fixed a bug with Chicago's roster that was causing the game to crash when that team was used.  They were using the old 'b' and 'w' variables for skin colors and didn't get updated to the new 1-6 method for skin colors.
   [*]The crowd should no longer cheer or boo with the sound turned off.
   [*]The playoff bracket will no longer cover the season stats.
   [*]The message that displays when you win the Axis Bowl on difficulties below Hall of Fame will no longer spill out of the containing background.
   [*]The opposing team will now properly call timeouts in Coach Mode.
[/list]


As always, thanks for your support!

-Danny

Danny@AxisGamesOnline.com

notes.title: Axis Football August Update v2.0 Live!
notes.content:
Patch 2.0 is live! Coach Mode, New Player Models, and More Modding!

Hi folks! Danny Jugan here with complete patch notes for Axis Football Patch 2.0

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Coach mode is now fully functional.  In Coach mode, players will select the plays, but will not need to control the players.  We plan to add additonal features for Coach mode in the future once we incorporate additional player attributes like fatigue. Coach mode is available for Quick Matches and can be toggled on/off for seasons under the season home screen.
   [*]Added Coach mode as an option for seasons.  You can now toggle between Coach mode and the normal Player mode at any point during any of your seasons.  Note that your preference is saved and will automatically default to your previous selection.
   [*]Added a camera view toggle button in Coach mode that the player can use to toggle between a sideline view and the normal player view (from behind the offense).
   [*]Preferences for sound on/off, announcer on/off, and pass aim sensitivity will now be saved.
   [*]Added a new way to cycle through players on defense before the ball is snapped.  You can now hold SHIFT and click or press X on the controller to cycle from the defensive line to linebackers and to defensive backs.
   [*]Season mode now tracks several team-based stats for the duration of the season.  You can view and sort the stats from the season home screen.  We plan to expanded stats to individual players in the future.
   [*]You can now fully mod both the home and away uniforms for every team!  As with all modding, open the Mods folder in the root directory of the game's folder.  There you will find a folder named Uniforms.  Open that folder and read the README.txt file for instructions.  You will need some sort of graphics editor program like Photoshop or Fireworks.
   [*]We have implemented brand new player models.  These models have higher texture resolution, higher poly count, and support normal maps (height/depth) for better visuals.  Please note that these models are still a work in progress. While they look good and are 100% functional, the The artist we've hired to create them is making some small adjustments and will be finished in the next few days. We didn't want to delay the update for these insignificant changes, but are aware that there are some small imperfections that most will not notice.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Increased the visibility of the passing circle.
   [*]Improved player AI on kickoffs. The kicking team will stay in their lanes better, and the return team will select more intelligent blocks. This helps prevent players from clustering or bunching together.
   [*]Improved the AI's offensive play selection when losing or when the game is close to being over.
   [*]Improved the AI's ability to select holes on running plays. You should see less of the runner colliding with their own players or running into blocked players.
   [*]AI quarterbacks will now intelligently scramble in situations where no receivers are open.
   [*]Improved AI quarterback throwing accuracy when attempting to lead receivers.
   [*]Increase the anisotropic level of the field giving it a better resolution when viewed at low angles.
   [*]Improved the logic for simulation games.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Removed the bug that was sometimes causing players to run around a spot on the field in circles.
   [*]Xbox controllers should now work with all Mac operating systems.
   [*]Fixed the bug that was sometimes causing the player's text to flicker on the screen.
   [*]Fixed the issue where calling timeout right before the ball was snapped would cause a lot of unexpected things to happen.
   [*]The announcer will no longer say that a two-point conversion has failed when the player gets tackled but his forward progress carries him into the endzone.
   [*]Fixed the bug where if you selected a run play, then audibled to another run play, the runner was unable to pick up the ball.
   [*]The AI should now properly kick an onside kick when they're in an onside kick formation.  Previously, they would line up for an onside kick, then kick it all the way down the field.
   [*]Fixed the bug where the announcer would say there was a safety eventhough the runner's forward progress carried them out of the endzone.
   [*]The crowd will no longer cheer if the sound has been turned off.
   [*]Fixed the scheduling bug in season mode simulation where Dallas was playing an extra game and Denver was playing one less game. Note that this fix will only affect new seasons, not seasons that are already underway.
   [*]Fixed the playoff seeding. Teams will now be placed into a playoff in such a way that teams with higher regular season ranks will be awarded home field advantage.
   [*]The clock should now stop at appropriate times.
[/list]

Our next update in planned for September.  We already have several features that we plan on implementing and will release September patch notes soon!

As always, thanks for your support!

-Danny
@AxisGamesDev
@AxisFootball
Danny@AxisGamesOnline.com

notes.title: Axis Football is an unintentional ode to high school football
notes.content:
High school can be a difficult time in the life of a teenager, especially nowadays. For me, it wasn t so bad. Madden was still releasing on the PC and I was able to continually appease my father, community, and harrowing self-doubt by tossing the ol pigskin around with my peers. Playing football in high school taught me grave lessons and gave me some of my greatest memories, a few I still carry with me today. For example, when I bend my right knee too far, pain shoots throughout my leg and I get a sudden sensation that hot water is running from my head to my feet. I sure do miss playing the sport of football.

Unfortunately, today s PC-playing youth has been without a proper American football simulation for years. They can t take the lessons that Madden annually doles out with them into the real world of football. Instead, they re left on the sidelines as their console-playing peers surpass them, leaving smiles on dads everywhere they turn.

But just a few days ago, Axis Football 2015 landed on Steam. After spending time with it, I'm happy to report that it s the closest video game approximation of high school football ever.

It's very unfriendly

Even if you don t know how to play the American game of football, you do know that it involves getting yelled at by older men about how you re not trying hard enough or to be stronger and better at everything. Axis Football 2015 approximates this feeling by being very obtuse and hard to understand.

Performing well in Axis will be very difficult and entirely up to luck. You ll get some tips from the game, but I was so nervous that I closed them before I could read them. Something about how to pass I think. The controls are listed in the launcher, but not the in-game options, so I just jammed around on the keyboard with reckless abandon.

It s just like high school football, when you get handy tips from your coach. Mine used yell stuff like, Red gun, red gun! Damnit, Davenport, red gun! but I was never listening, usually trying to establish eye contact with my dad in the crowd. And if anything went wrong, I d just blame my buddy Joe for not being as strong and tough as he could be.

The AI players are as smart as actual teen footballers

The attention to detail here is unreal. Watch how everyone runs in place directly around the ball before falling down in a lazy dogpile instead of actually picking up the ball, the most desirous object in American Football, and running towards the endzone with it. Fascinating. I d like to take a dive into the minds behind the minds, see how they know what makes a teen tick.

The crowd is full of dead, uninterested people

Just like in high school, the people you want in the crowd are late, left early, or didn t come at all. And if they did, they ve put on a face that says, Help! I m stuck here! It is so very cold!

It cups your butt on the sidelines for a little too long before sending you in for your buddy Joe.

Obviously, this is figurative language. Axis Football 2015 does not have any extremities, so it can t cup your butt at all. But between the grey inanimate crowd, the amateur announcer, and the overwhelming sense of bearing witness to something wrong, Axis Football 2015 did a fine job making me slightly uncomfortable before the adrenaline rush from scoring or tackling another (virtual) man to the ground returned my mind to its blank state.

Native Americans are still mascots

During my junior year, I had a coach that would often tell very loud, angry jokes about people that didn t look and behave exactly like him. Axis Football 2015 doesn t simulate an angry, sad old man, but in a bold move, the developers managed to preserve the NFL's (and plenty of high schools') overt tolerance for racism with its plays on their team names: the Kansas City Chiefs are the Indians, and the Washington Redskins are the Savages (softened somewhat with a logo of a lion).

It s the only light in your life

In high school, football was the only thing that kept me going. If I didn t have practice that day, it was much harder to do anything, like think about football or play football video games or sustain eye contact with my father.

Axis Football 2015 is the only simulation PC gamers have been given in a long time. While it doesn t measure up to contemporary Madden or NCAA games, it does something much more with much less. It's the only gridiron game in the PC's vacuous sports void, it's the expired ramen in your college pantry on a Saturday night. Axis Football 2015 isn't a bright beacon on the way to football paradise, but it gives PC forlorn footballers a flicker of fun to tackle and juke by.

As earnest as the attempt here is, I have a hard time recommending Axis Football 2015. It s an ugly reminder of better days gone by, no matter how sweet and tough and strong those memories might be.

notes.title: Roster Mod Instructions
notes.content:
Axis Football 2015 comes with basic roster mod support, and our first update (scheduled for mid August) will feature additional layers of modding (player stats and team uniforms).

If you would like to modify the rosters in the game, simply follow these steps:

1) Right-click on the game (Axis Football 2015) in your Steam library.
2) Selection 'Properties'
3) Click on the 'Local Files' tab
4) Click on the 'Browse Local Files' button
5) Open the 'Rosters' folder
6) Find the .txt document for the team you want to edit
7) Change out the player name, number, or race.
8) Save the file and launch the game

A few notes:

1) Do not edit the positions.  Those aren't read into the game, they're there for you to see which player you're editing
2) Don't remove the *. Those are needed as delimiters so that the game can separate the information when it's parsed in.
3) I would strongly suggest keeping a backup of the rosters in the event that you screw something up.  Worst case scenario, just redownload the game to get the default rosters back.

notes.title: Local Multiplayer - Done! Rosters Mods In the Works!
notes.content:
Hey folks!  Danny Jugan here with a quick update on Axis Football 2015.
I'm happy to announce that we've finished implementing local 2P games (using two controllers), and it's actually a ton of fun! notes.title: Axis Football Plans - Present & Future
notes.content:
Hi folks!  Danny Jugan here, creator of Axis Football.  I'd first like to say that I appreciate all of the feedback and suggestions given about the game. As we near the July 15th release date, I wanted to take a quick moment and shed some light on our current and future plans and perceptions to hopefully answer some of your questions about the game. Some points:

[olist]
[*] I don't intend for this game to be a Madden killer. It's obvious that the two games are on different levels, and Madden does a lot of things really well. I made this game because I love football games and felt that players would enjoy playing something different. Yes, when compared directly with the strength of Madden, this game will come up short, but there are a lot of features that Axis Football can (and will) provide that Madden does not. Such as...
[*] The mouse-aimed passing system is by far the best feature of the game. It's a blast, and it simply allows you to feel more like a QB than the standard button passing system.
[*] My vision for Axis Football is long-term. The first installment (2014), featured basic quick match and season play. In 2015, I added several features both mechanically, graphically, and conceptually. My goal is to continue to add major features each year with the revenue generated from game sales. I made Axis Football with a $450 budget. With a more serious budget, I could make something truly great.
[*] I honestly care about, listen, and act upon player feedback. I hope my track record speaks for itself here, but the features I implemented in Axis Football 2015 were directly from player feedback from 2014. On top of that, once the game was Greenlit, there was overwhelming feedback (more like hate ;-) ) about three particular features: 1) No controller support, 2) The football carry animation, and 3) No multiplayer. I have since updated the run animation, I'm 98% done with controller support, and I'm implementing 2-P local multiplayer. All of those will be in the game at it's release on July 15th.
[*] A few f\uers have mentioned that they haven't heard of Axis Games. While it's true that Axis Football has been going on since 2009, Axis Games was initially an exclusive Flash Game development company. It was until 2013 that I officially switched over to making PC games. So, even though we've been around since ~2004, unless you were big into the Flash Game scene or are fans of the Hands of War series, you probably never heard of us, but that doesn't mean we weren't making games ;-)
[*] So what can we expect to see in the future from Axis Football? I thought I'd take a second to list the features that are top on the list of things to add in the next update/version of the game. Here is what is currently in the plan:
[/olist]

[list]
Axis Football 2015 Free Update (~September, 2015)
[*] Oculus Rift support
[*] Spin/Juke moves
[*] Playoff on-field graphics
[/list]

[list]
Axis Football 2016 (~July, 2016)
[*]Complete GUI overhaul (the current theme looks out-dated)
[*]Franchise mode complete with player draft between seasons
[*]Season stats
[*]Modding support
[*]New Jersey textures
[*]Hot Routes called from line of scrimmage (we'll still keep audibles)
[*]Touchdown dances
[*]Polish: (update linemen animations when they're in a block, AI improvements, etc.)
[/list]

To sum everything up, I know Axis Football doesn't have everything that you want it to have - yet! It's going to take some time to get all of the features that you have come to expect. I'm asking for your support in helping build a football game franchise that gives players options. I'm in this for the long-haul. If you decide not to purchase the game when it releases, I ask that you at least mention it to a friend!

As always, thanks for your support. If you have suggestions or feedback, please feel free to reach out to me at any of the contact mediums below!

Facebook - fb.com/AxisGames
Twitter - twitter.com/AxisGamesDev

Happy Gaming,

Danny Jugan
danny@AxisGamesOnline.com

We know that online multiplayer is something that a lot of you have requested.  I can promise that we're working on it, but we won't have it in the initial release of the game. It will be added in as a free update shortly after launch.

Thanks for all the support!

Happy Gaming,

Danny Jugan
Axis Games
